title: Hepatocytes promote liver metastasis of pancreatic cancer by providing serine.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Pulled GEO (Gene Expression Omnibus) summaries for GSE324743 (24 samples) and GSE324997 (16 samples), both mouse bulk RNA-seq. Downloaded and parsed both processed files: GSE324743_RNAseq_Exp1-gene_fpkm.txt.gz (54,532 genes x 24 sample columns named WT_1..WT_12, KO_1..KO_12) and GSE324997_RNAseq_exp2-gene_fpkm.txt.gz (54,532 genes x 16 columns Hepato_1..Hepato_16). FPKM (fragments per kilobase per million reads) values plus Ensembl gene IDs and gene annotation columns.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only (paywalled, no PMCID, no Europe PMC full text or supplement). The mapping of WT_/KO_/Hepato_ columns to culture conditions (serine/glycine, hepatocyte co-culture, CXCR2 inhibitor) is inferred from GEO sample titles; no mapping file was found. Mouse metastasis and survival measurements described in the abstract were not found in any repository.

a1_downloadable.note: Both GEO processed FPKM matrices downloaded without login (3.8 MB and 4.5 MB, checked).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No outcome column exists; the only 'labels' are experimental design factors (Phgdh knockout vs wild type, serine in medium, co-culture, inhibitor), and the column names (WT_1, KO_7, Hepato_3) must be matched to conditions by hand from GEO sample titles. Checked in files.

a3_inputs_present.note: Gene-level FPKM expression values are present in the files with Ensembl IDs.

a4_units_stated.note: Files are named and described as gene FPKM (checked file names and values).

a5_enough_rows.note: 40 samples total (24 + 16) across 4-8 conditions with 3-4 replicates each; far below the ~400-row minimum. Counted in files.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: GEO sample counts (24, 16) match the number of columns in each matrix; the paper's own counts were not seen (no full text).

a8_label_provenance.note: Condition labels are experimental design, not model output; but they are not a measured outcome either.

honest_claim_h3: With 40 bulk RNA-seq samples from controlled mouse cell co-culture experiments, a model could only classify which experimental condition a sample came from, which differential expression analysis already answers.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use gene expression of cultured mouse liver and pancreatic cancer cells to predict which serine or co-culture condition they were grown in.
plain_idea.train_on: Whole-transcriptome expression profiles of 40 cultured samples (24 cancer-cell, 16 liver-cell), 54,532 genes each.
plain_idea.predict: The experimental condition (serine-synthesis gene knocked out or not, serine in the medium or not, co-culture, inhibitor), set by the experimenters rather than measured.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Little: the conditions are known by design and 3-4 replicates per group only support standard differential expression, not machine learning.

ml_idea: None viable. The only deposited data are two small bulk RNA-seq designed experiments (40 samples); the in vivo metastasis and survival data are not deposited.

effort.compute_note: Files opened and parsed in seconds; no ML task to time.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count samples in the GEO matrices: 40 total, done — fails A5.

verdict_reason: Fails A5 and A2: the only deposited data are two bulk RNA-seq experiments with 40 cultured mouse samples in total (counted in the files), and the 'labels' are the designed culture conditions, not a measured outcome. This is a mechanism paper suited to differential expression, not ML.
